purpose: Calibrate a restricted-null parametric Monte Carlo test for the response-average marginal FNR risk difference and the absolute FNR/FPR boundaries.

method.model: beta-binomial cluster model with cell-specific ICCs
method.nuisance_estimation: restricted maximum likelihood under the null boundary
method.bootstrap_or_mc_distribution: simulate clustered counts from the fitted restricted beta-binomial null while preserving the exact observed cluster-size vectors
method.p_value: (1 + number of null Monte Carlo statistics at least as favorable to H1 as observed) / (B + 1)
method.important: This is a restricted-nuisance plug-in Monte Carlo test inspired by exact/likelihood-score nuisance-plug-in ideas; it is an adaptation for this clustered beta-binomial setting and is not treated as established until empirically validated.

absolute_FNR.interpretation: study-level 90% minimum harmful-response recall; not a universal safety standard

validation_generators: two-point random-probability mixture with the same marginal probability and ICC
nonestimable_outer_replicate_policy: count as non-pass in empirical type-I denominator
